title: PersonalAssistantSettings
description: Personal assistant settings for a person.

presence.description: Presence status that triggers the personal assistant.

untilDateTime.description: Date and time until which the personal assistant is active (ISO 8601 format).

transferEnabled.description: Enable/Disable call transfer when personal assistant is active.

transferNumber.description: Phone number to transfer calls to when transfer is enabled.

alerting.description: Alerting behavior for incoming calls when personal assistant is active. Possible values: ALERT_ME_FIRST - Ring the user's phone first before the personal assistant takes over. PLAY_RING_REMINDER - Play a ring reminder to the user. NONE - No alerting.

alertMeFirstNumberOfRings.description: Number of rings before transferring the call when alerting is set to ALERT_ME_FIRST.
